sc_cat_item_producer.description:
Use this form to claim back an expense you paid for yourself. Tell us what you spent, when you spent it and why, and attach your receipt or supporting document.

Your claim is checked automatically as soon as you submit it, and then sent for approval. You can follow its progress at any time on the My Claims page of the ClaimEase portal.
sc_cat_item_producer.name: Submit a Reimbursement Claim

sc_cat_item_producer.short_description: Claim back an expense you paid for yourself, and attach your receipt.
